Commands v3 Field Guide

Learn to write and troubleshoot Commands v3 if you already know Commands v2. This guide uses Java and WPILib 2027 Alpha 8.

Learn in three lessons

  1. Commands v3 - Java plus a Coroutine — See how v3 lets you compose commands with ordinary Java, then trace a pause and resume driven by a Coroutine.
  2. Translate an intake command — Compare the v2 and v3 code and follow the motor cleanup on cancellation.
  3. Coordinate mechanisms — Choose between a command group and a coroutine based on when each mechanism must be reserved.

Find an answer while coding

  • Migration — Diagnose a builder that will not compile, a held button that runs once, or a default that fails to come back.
  • Examples — Find code for sensor waits, operator controls, and autonomous routines.
  • v2 method lookup — Start with the v2 name, such as startEnd, deadline, or withName.
  • v3 method lookup — Browse the Alpha 8 API by topic or search a method to see how and when to use it.
